body: Merge-up of origin/main into agy2/story-1688 pushed at fff57f49a2 (no force). Not fixed per brief (add nothing else); needs a ruling: fix both files here via the test_git helper, or a separate main fix first. Also ran 'cargo reap --apply' (disk below 15G floor): reaped merged bug-2130 + story-1700-mergeup target dirs (82G).
